# Online Service

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:OnlineService`](gmeow-OnlineService.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/OnlineService>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/accounts`](../../slices/accounts.md)

An online service or platform an account is held with — a social network, code forge, email provider, or federated instance. Carries the service's liveness ([`gmeow:serviceStatus`](../properties/gmeow-serviceStatus.md) / [`gmeow:serviceShutdownDate`](../properties/gmeow-serviceShutdownDate.md)) so historical services (Yahoo 360, Google+) remain first-class with their shutdown recorded.
